description: Card layout, alignment, typography, color, and composition rules. Extracted from uploaded card-rules.json and Cards.png design spec.

sizing.padding: 24px (sp-6 on all four sides — this is the default, not 50px)
sizing.paddingHorizontalMax: 48px (sp-12 — ceiling only, not default; snapped from 50px per spacing audit)
sizing.borderNote: Use accent3 (Badlands #DEDFE0) NOT accent (Granite #77787B). Granite is for tables and modal dividers.

imageText: Image is full-width at card top — no padding around it (bleeds to card edges)
All content below image is left-aligned — center alignment never permitted with image
Title, body, and buttons stack vertically below image in that order
Up to two buttons sit inline below the body text
textOnly: Center alignment is permitted only when no image is present
No icon is allowed in vertical layout under any circumstance

imageText: Image is fixed-width on the left, stretching to full card height (align-self: stretch)
Content sits to the right of the image, left-aligned, top-aligned
iconText: Icon can sit beside the title OR above the title — both valid in horizontal icon-text only
Icon beside title: icon and title share the same row, center-aligned vertically
Icon above title: icon is centered above the title text
Card content is always middle-aligned vertically in horizontal icon-text cards
Icon color: dark-sky on white cards, white on filled cards

general: No border — background defines the container
All text and icons must be white
Use outlined button with white border and white label
Use sparingly — one filled card per layout section at most

rules: Always use h4 token for card titles — never raw pixel values
Always use body-sm token for card body — never raw pixel values

border.name: Badlands
border.note: Use accent3 NOT accent — Granite is for modal dividers and table borders

rules: Never use foundation reds for card borders
Never use semantic colors as card background or border
Never use lab-blue for card title or body — lab-blue is for links only

icon.placement: Beside or above the title — horizontal icon-text ONLY
rules: Only valid in horizontal icon-text variant — NEVER in vertical cards
Icon beside title: same row, center-aligned
Icon above title: centered above title — only in horizontal cards
Never truncate — let card grow in height

buttons.placement: Below body text, pinned to card bottom (marginTop: auto)
rules: Buttons always side-by-side on one row — never stacked or wrapped
On filled cards: outlined variant with white border
On white cards: solid-primary for first button, outlined for second

linkCard.description: Card where title and body act as a navigational link. No button.

colorOverride.title: lab-blue (#306385)
colorOverride.note: Only context where lab-blue is permitted on card title/body — because the content IS a link

compositionRules: Do not mix more than one filled card in the same row or section
Do not use icons in vertical cards — icons are only valid in horizontal cards
Do not exceed two buttons per card
Do not allow cards to shrink below 240×150px
All cards in the same row must be the same height — tallest card defines row height
Buttons inside a card are always side by side — they never stack or wrap
